sections.h2: Belleview fences and how they wear
body: Wood privacy fences are a common sight around Belleview's subdivisions, from the established streets of Robin Hood Forest and Belleview Heights Estates to newer construction toward The Villages. They wear unevenly. The sun-facing side bleaches gray, the base stays damp from lawn irrigation and grows mildew, and pickets near gates loosen first. Fence painting in Belleview, FL means treating those zones, not just rolling color over them.

Gray, weathered wood holds a layer of damaged fibers that stain cannot bond to well. We wash and treat mildew, then let the fence dry before any finish goes on. Loose or split pickets, failing rails, and rusted hardware are repaired or replaced as listed in the estimate. Where an old film coating is peeling, it is stripped and sanded first. Our article on treating sun-damaged wood fences walks through the same steps.
Plantings, siding, and anything near the fence line are masked before application.

Gates and posts get extra attention. Post bases sit in wet soil and are often the first part of a fence to soften, and gate hardware loosens as the frame moves. We note those on the walkthrough so repairs happen before finish goes on.

For wood fences, we usually recommend penetrating stain, sprayed and back-brushed so it works into the grain. It fades gradually rather than peeling, so the next refresh is simpler. Paint is a fit for fences that are already painted, for owners who want a bold solid color, and for faded vinyl fencing.
bullets: Transparent stain: most grain, least sun protection
Solid stain: hides repairs and mismatched boards
Paint: crisp color over primed wood or cleaned vinyl

body: Fence projects run best between October and May, when wood dries quickly between washing and staining. Most start one to three weeks after approval. If you share the fence with a neighbor, we can stain your side only or coordinate both sides when everyone agrees. Pair it with deck staining in Belleview to match the backyard, read our Florida deck and fence staining guide, or go back to the Belleview painting contractor page.

faqs.q: Can you stain a brand-new fence in Belleview?
faqs.a: New pressure-treated wood usually needs time to dry before it accepts stain. We check the wood and schedule the work when it is ready.
Yes. Sun-faded vinyl panels can be washed and coated using a paint formulated for vinyl.

faqs.q: Will you stain both sides of my fence?
faqs.a: We can. The estimate lists which sides are included, so there is no confusion with neighbors.

faqs.q: Can you match my fence stain to my deck?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a board, a sample, or a leftover can and confirm the color on your fence before finishing the full run.
